settings.language.note: Translated: the pages' labels, buttons, tips and menus. Status and error messages, and text sent by the server, are still in English. Languages other than English are first drafts awaiting review by native speakers.
dashboard.copyId.tip: Copy the full canonical World ID.
dashboard.memory.tip: Current PalServer memory relative to the recent history peak.
dashboard.rcon.tip: RCON state from the active PalWorldSettings.ini. Open Console for Doctor and legacy RCON commands.
dashboard.scan.tip: Run Doctor checks immediately, in place. Use the ribbon's Doctor button to open the full Doctor page.
dashboard.save.tip: Force-saves the world immediately, via RCON (Save) -- the same effect as the server's own periodic autosave, on demand.
dashboard.cleanup.tip: BACKEND REQUIRED: cleanup is not enabled until a safe server-side cleanup contract exists.
dashboard.fps.tip: Real in-game simulation FPS from Palworld's own REST API, sampled over the same history as CPU/Memory above.
ui.review_palworld_dedicated_server_upda: Review Palworld dedicated-server update readiness and execute validated SteamCMD updates.
ui.open_the_official_page_to_check_this_: Open the official page to check this manually.
ui.use_refresh_in_the_ribbon_to_check_ev: Use "Refresh" in the ribbon to check every component's installed and latest version.
ui.palserver_must_be_stopped_this_action: PalServer must be stopped. This action updates the Palworld Dedicated Server through the configured SteamCMD installation. It does not update the MystTiq application.
ui.open_protected_validation_transaction: Open protected validation, transaction and recovery workflows.
ui.world_explorer_is_read_only_in_this_p: World Explorer is read-only in this phase. It inventories active world/save files but does not decode, modify, restore, move, or delete save data.
ui.read_only_structural_evidence_no_loca: Read-only structural evidence; no local GUI filesystem inspection or world mutation.
ui.review_guild_owned_base_references_an: Review guild-owned base references and the authoritative guild evidence that ties bases to ownership.
ui.review_guild_identity_leadership_memb: Review guild identity, leadership, membership, and base-reference evidence.
ui.player_save_identity_comes_from_valid: Player save identity comes from validated 32-character Players/*.sav filenames. Player names, guild membership, leadership and base counts are shown only when authoritative decoded GroupSaveDataMap evidence is available. Live REST data may enrich currently-online player name/platform evidence.
ui.this_phase_is_read_only_player_guild_: This phase is read-only. Player/guild repair, migration, leadership transfer and character modification remain later administration workflows.
ui.search_guild_id_leader_or_player_id: Search guild, ID, leader, or player ID
ui.applies_to_the_selected_guild_above_r: Applies to the selected guild above. Requires PalServer stopped. Claim is only offered for guilds showing Orphaned / Needs Review; Transfer and Add Player work on any guild; Remove Broken Member is only offered when the target player has no matching save file. Follows Preview → Safety Backup → Server-side Transaction → Validate → Journal/Audit → Refresh GUI.
ui.i_reviewed_this_plan_and_confirm_the_: I reviewed this plan and confirm the active Palworld server is stopped.
ui.search_base_id_guild_or_leader: Search base ID, guild, or leader
ui.applies_to_the_selected_base_above_mo: Applies to the selected base above. Moves the base's base_ids entry between guild records and retags every structure/container/worker record placed at that base (confirmed against real save data: ~130 records per base) to the new owning guild. Requires PalServer stopped. Follows Preview → Safety Backup → Server-side Transaction → Validate → Journal/Audit → Refresh GUI.
ui.applies_to_the_selected_base_above_pe: Applies to the selected base above. Permanently removes the base's base_ids entry and every structure/container/worker record tagged to it (matching the legacy app's DeleteBaseAndOwnedObjects operation) rather than reassigning them. This cannot be undone except by restoring the safety backup created during Apply. Requires PalServer stopped. Follows Preview → Safety Backup → Server-side Transaction → Validate → Journal/Audit → Refresh GUI.
ui.i_reviewed_this_plan_and_confirm_the_: I reviewed this plan and confirm the active Palworld server is stopped. I understand this permanently deletes the base and its owned objects.
ui.generates_a_random_server_browser_nam: Generates a random server-browser name locally; Save Changes is still required.
ui.selecting_a_preset_applies_it_immedia: Selecting a preset applies it immediately.
ui.saves_every_currently_loaded_setting_: Saves every currently-loaded setting value as a new named preset, stored locally on this machine.
ui.search_setting_name_category_or_descr: Search setting name, category, or description
ui.advanced_settings_exposes_every_known: Advanced Settings exposes every known and custom OptionSettings entry returned by the server. Unknown settings are preserved. Highlighted rows differ from Palworld's default.
ui.simple_settings_shows_server_identity: Simple Settings shows server identity, connectivity, and the most useful gameplay/QoL controls. Switch to Advanced Settings for the complete OptionSettings list.
ui.clear_to_return_this_option_to_its_de: Clear to return this option to its default value.
ui.solid_green_dots_are_online_players_a: Solid green dots are online players, at their live position from Palworld's REST API. Hollow grey rings are offline players, at the last position the save recorded for them. Amber squares are guild bases, and violet circles are owned Pals (at bases or in parties). Bases, Pals and offline players come from the world save, so they show even when the server is stopped.
ui.scroll_to_zoom_drag_to_pan_click_a_ma: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, click a marker or a name to zoom in on it.
ui.zooms_back_out_to_the_whole_map: Zooms back out to the whole map.
ui.draws_players_who_are_not_online_at_t: Draws players who are not online at the last position their save recorded. This is where the game last saved them, not a live position.
ui.re_reads_online_players_and_base_loca: Re-reads online players and base locations.
ui.places_players_and_guild_bases_on_the: Places players and guild bases on the Palpagos map from their real world coordinates. Accurate to within a few pixels of the map image, so read a dot as the right spot on the map rather than an exact survey point. Untick to use the relative-position view instead, which cannot show bases.
ui.pick_the_palpagos_preset_above_to_see: Pick the Palpagos preset above to see real player and base positions. The World Tree preset and your own images can only spread dots relative to each other.
ui.show_pals_at_bases_and_in_parties: Show Pals (at bases and in parties)
ui.violet_circles_are_owned_pals_at_the_: Violet circles are owned Pals, at the last position the save recorded: working at a base, or travelling in a player's party. Pals close together share one circle with a count; zoom in to separate them. Palbox Pals and wild Pals are not drawn.
ui.online_offline_last_known_position_cl: ● online   ○ offline (last known position). Click a name to zoom in on it and select that player.
ui.summons_the_selected_online_player_to: Summons the selected online player to your admin character, via RCON. Needs an admin character in the world.
ui.moves_your_admin_character_to_the_sel: Moves your admin character to the selected online player, via RCON. Needs an admin character in the world.
ui.palworld_s_vanilla_rcon_has_no_telepo: Palworld's vanilla RCON has no teleport-to-coordinates command, so these buttons can only target a player. With PalDefender, Teleport Points below can send a player to a saved spot.
ui.named_spots_players_can_teleport_to_f: Named spots players can teleport to from anywhere by typing a chat command, e.g. !tp spawn (or just !tp to list them). Needs PalDefender and RCON: MystTiq reads chat and runs PalDefender's tp for them. Palworld itself cannot allow fast travel from anywhere; that only exists as a client-side mod every player would install.
ui.let_players_use_the_chat_command: Let players use the chat command
ui.starts_with_or_so_it_never_clashes_wi: Starts with ! or . so it never clashes with PalDefender's own / commands.
ui.how_long_a_player_waits_between_telep: How long a player waits between teleports.
ui.one_per_line_name_then_x_y_optional_h:
One per line, name then X Y (optional height):
spawn -358 270
base 120 -44
ui.coordinates_are_paldefender_s_own_wha: Coordinates are PalDefender's own (what its getpos shows). Easiest: select an online player standing on the spot, press Capture, rename the new line, Save.
ui.asks_paldefender_where_the_selected_o: Asks PalDefender where the selected online player is standing and adds it as a new line.
ui.teleports_the_selected_online_player_: Teleports the selected online player to a saved point now, without them typing anything.
ui.violet_owned_pals_at_the_last_positio: ● violet: owned Pals at the last position the save recorded. Click a row to zoom in; hover a circle for who is there.
ui.in_game_map_coordinates_as_the_game_s: In-game map coordinates, as the game's own map shows them.
ui.search_player_id_guild_or_platform: Search player, ID, guild, or platform
ui.shows_only_one_row_per_player_name_pr: Shows only one row per player name (preferring online, then a known save, then most recently updated) -- the others still exist, they're just hidden from this list.
ui.select_a_player_right_click_online_re: Select a player; right-click online records for supported administration actions.
ui.available_only_while_the_selected_pla: Available only while the selected player is online.
ui.copies_inventory_recipes_records_skin: Copies inventory, recipes, records, skins, and quest progress from another player onto this one. Requires PalServer stopped.
ui.permanently_deletes_this_player_s_sav: Permanently deletes this player's save file and cleans up their guild membership. Requires PalServer stopped.
ui.gives_the_items_and_pals_typed_in_the: Gives the items and Pals typed in the Give box under Player Administration to this online player, through PalDefender over RCON.
ui.the_live_map_of_online_players_and_gu: The live map of online players and guild bases has its own page under World.
ui.kick_and_ban_route_through_the_palwor: Kick and Ban route through the Palworld REST API first, automatically falling back to RCON if REST is disabled or misconfigured, and are enabled only for an online player. Unsupported operations remain visibly disabled and cannot report false success.
ui.removes_the_selected_player_s_steam_u: Removes the selected player's Steam/UserID from the server's RCON ban list. Works for offline (banned) players.
ui.summons_the_selected_online_player_to: Summons the selected online player to your admin character's in-game location, via RCON. Requires an admin character actually present in the world.
ui.moves_your_admin_character_to_the_sel: Moves your admin character to the selected online player's in-game location, via RCON. Requires an admin character actually present in the world.
ui.duration_in_hours_before_this_ban_is_: Duration in hours before this ban is automatically lifted.
ui.bans_the_selected_online_player_immed: Bans the selected online player immediately (same as Ban above), then automatically unbans them after the duration set here.
ui.one_per_line_item_palsphere_10_pal_we:
One per line:
item PalSphere 10
pal WeaselDragon 5 (Pal id, then level)
ui.gives_these_to_the_selected_online_pl: Gives these to the selected online player, through PalDefender over RCON. Needs PalDefender installed and RCON enabled.
ui.lines_use_palworld_s_internal_ids_the: Lines use Palworld's internal ids (the same ones PalDefender and Starter Kits use); the finder below shows each one's name. Nothing is given unless the player is online.
ui.search_names_or_ids_e_g_pal_sphere_la: Search names or ids, e.g. pal sphere, lamball
ui.reads_the_item_and_pal_ids_that_occur: Reads the item and Pal ids that occur in this server's world save, plus ids used in kits or given before, then the rest of the game's items and Pals. Names come from this server's own game files when Python and its Oodle module are installed.
ui.items_how_many_1_to_1_000_000_pals_th: Items: how many (1 to 1,000,000). Pals: the level (1 to 100).
ui.adds_the_selected_id_as_a_new_line_in: Adds the selected id as a new line in the Give box above.
ui.adds_the_selected_id_to_the_kit_selec: Adds the selected id to the kit selected under Starter Kits. Press Save Kits there to keep it.
ui.read_directly_from_the_server_via_rco: Read directly from the server via RCON (BanList). Ban/Unban above use the same Steam/UserID shown here.
ui.sends_the_version_command_over_rcon_a: Sends the version command over RCON and shows the server's raw reply. The server must be running.
ui.tip_find_an_item_or_pal_under_player_: Tip: "Find an item or Pal" under Player Administration adds ids from this world to the selected kit.
ui.auto_gift_the_chosen_kit_to_new_playe: Auto-gift the chosen kit to new players
ui.gives_the_selected_kit_to_the_player_: Gives the selected kit to the player selected in the directory or on the map. The player must be online, and the kit must be saved first.
ui.lets_auto_gift_give_this_player_the_k: Lets auto-gift give this player the kit again if they qualify.
ui.individual_pal_stat_identity_editing_: Individual Pal stat/identity editing, decoded from the active world's Level.sav. Skill lists, species, and inventory are not editable yet.
ui.migrate_a_source_player_s_guild_membe: Migrate a source player's guild membership to an already-existing destination player identity (e.g. Xbox → Steam). Level/inventory/Pal transfer is not yet supported — only guild references migrate.
ui.filter_search_pause_and_export_the_co: Filter, search, pause and export the combined PalServer/MystTiq log view. Server logging continues while the view is paused.
ui.review_persistent_mysttiq_management_: Review persistent MystTiq management/API activity and audit events. Console output remains on the Live Console page.
ui.real_in_game_simulation_fps_from_palw: Real in-game simulation FPS from Palworld's own REST API (/v1/api/metrics) -- degrades with base/Pal count independent of host CPU%. Requires the Palworld REST API to be enabled.
ui.real_in_game_frame_time_from_palworld: Real in-game frame time from Palworld's own REST API (/v1/api/metrics). Requires the Palworld REST API to be enabled.
ui.reload_persistent_mysttiq_management_: Reload persistent MystTiq management and API activity.
ui.persistent_management_events_written_: Persistent management events written by the headless backend.
ui.audit_retention_is_append_only_from_t: Audit retention is append-only from the GUI. Persistent clear is intentionally policy-locked so management evidence cannot be silently erased.
ui.palworld_rcon_is_a_legacy_deprecated_: Palworld RCON is a legacy/deprecated administration interface. MystTiq keeps the AdminPassword server-side and never sends it to the GUI.
ui.rcon_command_for_example_info_showpla: RCON command (for example: Info, ShowPlayers, Save)
ui.i_understand_restore_replaces_the_act: I understand restore replaces the active save
ui.restore_requires_palserver_to_be_stop: Restore requires PalServer to be stopped. MystTiq creates a safety backup of the current save before replacing it.
ui.preview_is_immutable_and_short_lived_: Preview is immutable and short-lived. Apply deletes exactly that preview; any inventory change requires a new preview.
ui.inspect_the_active_runtime_resolver_m: Inspect the active runtime resolver, Mods roots, runtime evidence, and compatibility warnings.
ui.at_a_glance_operational_health_and_co: At-a-glance operational health and confirmed issues. Open MOD Library to browse, install, or change enabled state.
ui.mods_whose_confirmed_health_is_neithe: MODs whose confirmed health is neither Healthy, Disabled, nor Active / Unverified.
ui.all_mods_are_healthy_disabled_or_acti: All MODs are healthy, disabled, or active/unverified — nothing needs attention.
ui.read_only_here_open_mod_library_to_ch: Read-only here. Open MOD Library to change enabled state, install, delete, or update a MOD.
ui.select_a_mod_from_the_list_to_see_its: Select a MOD from the list to see its details here.
ui.inspect_installed_server_mod_packages: Inspect installed server MOD packages, install new ones, and control enabled state through the managed backend.
ui.the_gui_uploads_the_archive_to_the_he: The GUI uploads the archive to the headless server. Extraction is size-bounded, staged, and rejects absolute or traversal paths. PAK vs. UE4SS is detected automatically from the archive's own contents.
ui.or_drag_a_zip_file_here: or drag a ZIP file here
ui.scans_locally_installed_steam_worksho: Scans locally installed Steam Workshop content for Palworld (App ID 1623730) across all detected Steam libraries. Windows only — Workshop subscriptions live on the local Steam client.
ui.browse_palworld_mods_on_nexus_mods_an: Browse Palworld mods on Nexus Mods and install a ZIP straight into the server through the same validated install as Choose ZIP. Your API key stays on this PC and is never sent to the MystTiq server. Get one from nexusmods.com under your account's API keys.
ui.stores_the_key_on_this_pc_only_encryp: Stores the key on this PC only, encrypted for your Windows account.
ui.mod_id_or_nexusmods_com_page_url: Mod id or nexusmods.com page URL
ui.premium_accounts_only_because_nexus_o: Premium accounts only, because Nexus only issues direct download links to them. Free accounts: use Open on Nexus, or paste an nxm link below.
ui.free_account_paste_the_nxm_link_from_: Free account: paste the nxm:// link from the Mod Manager Download button
ui.mod_data_from_nexus_mods_nexusmods_co: Mod data from Nexus Mods (nexusmods.com). MystTiq is an independent project and is not affiliated with Nexus Mods.
ui.disabled_and_active_unverified_are_in: Disabled and Active / Unverified are informational states; only explicit enabled-MOD failures degrade health. Right-click a MOD for actions; Enable All/Disable All/Repair/Safe-Start Diagnostic are in the ribbon above.
ui.restores_this_mod_to_its_state_before: Restores this MOD to its state before the last Install or Delete. A snapshot is captured automatically on every install/delete.
ui.re_imports_this_mod_fresh_from_its_ma: Re-imports this MOD fresh from its matched local Steam Workshop copy, fixing missing or incomplete files. Fails honestly if no local Workshop source is known for it.
ui.only_fetches_when_clicked_never_autom: Only fetches when clicked -- never automatic.
ui.open_this_link_in_your_default_browse: Open this link in your default browser.
ui.no_known_workshop_match_set_a_source_: No known Workshop match -- set a Source URL (e.g. a GitHub repository) below, then Fetch again:
ui.select_a_mod_from_the_installed_mods_: Select a MOD from the Installed MODs list to see its details here.
ui.enable_disable_requires_palserver_to_: Enable/disable requires PalServer to be stopped. PAK state is managed through ~mods files. UE4SS state uses the resolver-selected active Mods root and mods.txt; enabled.txt overrides are neutralized.
ui.runtime_and_network_health_are_evalua: Runtime and network health are evaluated independently.
ui.support_output_excludes_passwords_bea: Support output excludes passwords, bearer tokens, certificate pins, URL credentials, query strings and fragments.
ui.adds_a_port_forward_mapping_on_your_r: Adds a port-forward mapping on your router via UPnP for the configured game port.
ui.public_ip_the_router_s_upnp_port_mapp: Public IP, the router's UPnP port mapping, and a second NAT (carrier-grade NAT or a router behind another router) are checked automatically. Nothing here can send a real game packet from outside, so a friend joining from outside is the true test. Palworld uses UDP, and most port-checker websites only test TCP.
ui.opens_a_well_known_external_port_chec: Opens a well-known external port-checker website in your browser.
ui.diagnoses_the_selected_connection_pro: Diagnoses the selected connection profile from THIS machine -- DNS, TCP, TLS, then HTTP -- works even when the server is fully unreachable.
ui.all_palworld_instances_on_this_machin: ALL PALWORLD INSTANCES ON THIS MACHINE
ui.every_palworld_process_on_this_machin: Every Palworld process on this machine, not just the one this tab manages. Select an instance to see details and available actions.
ui.managed_by_this_tab_use_the_safe_cras: Managed by this tab. Use the safe, crash-recovery-aware stop path instead of a raw kill.
ui.not_confirmed_as_this_tab_s_own_manag: Not confirmed as this tab's own managed process. MystTiq cannot know whether this PID is tracked by a different local MystTiq session's own crash-recovery — killing it directly may look like an unexpected crash to that session and trigger an auto-restart there, instead of a clean stop.
ui.select_an_instance_above_to_see_detai: Select an instance above to see details and available actions.
ui.no_palworld_instances_detected_on_thi: No Palworld instances detected on this machine yet. Use "Detect Instances" in the ribbon or run the Doctor to scan.
ui.review_validate_and_open_every_mystti: Review, validate, and open every MystTiq working location. Managed server paths remain authoritative on the headless host.
ui.local_paths_are_enabled_only_for_the_: Local paths are enabled only for the local profile.
ui.environment_checks_come_from_the_mana: Environment checks come from the managed server.
ui.browse_open_are_local_profile_only_re: Browse/Open are local-profile-only. Remote paths are validated and saved by the authenticated headless configuration service.
ui.import_archive_workflow_analyze_accep: Import archive workflow: Analyze → Accept Options → Review Plan → Apply. World Import replaces the active world; Player Recovery overlays only canonical Players/<32-hex>.sav files. Guild ownership repair (Claim/Transfer/Add Player) is live from the Guilds page; Base ownership transfer and recovery (v0.5.3.0/v0.5.4.0) are live from the Bases page.
ui.every_accepted_mutation_records_previ: Every accepted mutation records preview acceptance, fresh backup, staging, atomic swap, post-validation, completion or rollback.
ui.cross_feature_view_of_the_shared_oper: Cross-feature view of the shared operation coordinator — World Transactions, Guild Ownership and Base Ownership/Recovery all run through it and are rejected from running concurrently against the same world.
ui.each_finding_matches_a_known_failure_: Each finding matches a known failure pattern and comes with a plain-language cause and things to try. MystTiq reports what the logs say and what it usually means; it never promotes a successful-load line or last-message proximity into an invented cause. Findings marked NEW appeared since the previous analysis, so running it again does not re-raise the same old lines.
ui.inspection_is_read_only_save_mutation: Inspection is read-only. Save mutation remains behind the reviewed World Transaction workflow and its backup, confirmation, staging and rollback protections.
ui.there_are_no_automation_rules_so_no_b: There are no automation rules, so no backup runs on its own: a backup only exists when someone presses Backup. The New Rule form below is already set up as a nightly backup at 03:00 UTC: type a name such as 'Nightly backup' and press Create.
ui.name: Name
ui.used_only_when_trigger_is_idleempty_s: Used only when Trigger is IdleEmpty: stop after this many minutes with 0 online players.
ui.title: Title
ui.fires_when_an_enabled_mod_reports_fai: Fires when an enabled MOD reports Failed/Missing/Misconfigured/Attention
ui.how_often_a_still_active_condition_se: How often a still-active condition sends a 'Still active: ...' follow-up. Applies to every rule above. The original alert is unaffected either way.
ui.send_crash_recovery_alerts_crashed_re: Send crash-recovery alerts (crashed, restart failed, gave up)
ui.also_send_server_is_back_up_notices: Also send "server is back up" notices
ui.muted_alerts_are_not_queued_crash_ale: Muted alerts are not queued. Crash alerts skipped during a mute are still written to the Activity log.
ui.creates_a_test_notification_through_t: Creates a test notification through the normal path: it appears on the Notifications page and goes to every switched-on channel unless delivery is paused.
ui.unlike_mute_alerts_nothing_is_silence: Unlike Mute Alerts, nothing is silenced in MystTiq itself: alerts and notifications keep appearing on the Notifications page. Only the outside sends stop, and each skipped send is written to the Activity log.
ui.guild_scoped_slash_commands_mysttiq_s: Guild-scoped slash commands (/mysttiq-status, players, start, stop, restart, broadcast, save, backup, kick, ban, unban) run against this server from Discord, gated by the role mapping below: status and players need Viewer, server control, save and backup need Operator, kick, ban and unban need Admin. Kick and Ban autocomplete from the players online right now. Connects outbound to Discord's gateway, so no public endpoint is exposed.
ui.always_granted_the_owner_role_bypassi: Always granted the Owner role, bypassing role mapping
ui.optional_one_self_updating_status_mes: Optional. One self-updating status message is kept here
ui.optional_players_joining_or_leaving_s: Optional. Players joining or leaving, server started or stopped
ui.role_mapping_discord_role_id_mysttiq_: Role mapping (Discord role ID → MystTiq role)
ui.every_rule_defaults_to_flag_notify_lo: Every rule defaults to Flag (notify + log only). Switch a rule to Kick or Ban to have MystTiq act automatically through the same moderation path the Discord bot and REST API already use.
ui.new_token_shown_once_copy_it_now: New token (shown once — copy it now)
ui.people_who_sign_in_with_a_username_an: People who sign in with a username and password (Settings → Sign in). Each has a role (Viewer, Operator, Admin, Owner) and can be limited to one server. Sessions last 12 hours; 5 wrong passwords lock an account for 15 minutes. Needs authentication on for this MystTiq.
ui.new_password_for_the_selected_account: New password for the selected account
ui.sets_a_new_password_and_signs_the_acc: Sets a new password and signs the account out everywhere.
ui.a_disabled_account_cannot_sign_in_and: A disabled account cannot sign in and its open sessions end at once.
ui.runs_across_every_configured_server_p: Runs across every configured server profile, staggered so they don't all fire at once.
ui.duplicates_the_currently_connected_pr: Duplicates the currently connected profile's entire installation (game binaries + world/config) into a brand-new profile, with ports offset so both can run together. The source server must be stopped first. The new profile requires a MystTiq service restart to come online.
ui.source_the_connection_this_tab_curren: SOURCE (the connection this tab currently uses)
ui.added_to_the_source_server_s_own_port: Added to the source server's own ports (game, query, REST API) so both installations can run at the same time without colliding.
ui.i_understand_this_copies_the_entire_s: I understand this copies the entire server installation and can take a while.
ui.restart_mysttiq_now_to_bring_it_onlin: Restart MystTiq Now to Bring It Online
ui.for_a_remote_server_this_is_the_serve: For a remote server, this is the server's own machine, not this PC.
ui.server_priority_eco_mode_and_cores: Server priority, eco mode and cores
ui.applies_to_this_server_s_own_processe: Applies to this server's own processes (on Windows the game itself runs as PalServer-Win64-Shipping-Cmd.exe) and is kept through restarts and crashes. MystTiq applies it as soon as the server starts and checks it every 15 seconds.
ui.how_much_the_server_may_send_to_each_: How much the server may send to each player, and how often it updates them. These are the game's own network settings in the server's Engine.ini; MystTiq writes them just before every start and changes nothing else in that file.
ui.fewer_network_updates_per_second_use_: Fewer network updates per second use less upload and processor, but movement looks less smooth; more than 60 costs processor for little gain.
ui.traffic_of_the_whole_machine_through_: Traffic of the whole machine through each adapter, not only the server's.
ui.the_disks_holding_something_of_this_s: The disks holding something of this server come first.
ui.accent_theme_mode_and_density_applies: Accent theme, mode and density. Applies immediately and is remembered for next time.
ui.midnight_is_true_black_for_oled_scree: Midnight is true black, for OLED screens. High contrast is white text and borders on black. Follow the system matches your computer's light or dark setting and changes with it. Compact density fits more on screen.
ui.remove_the_saved_encrypted_token_for_: Remove the saved encrypted token for this profile (does not clear what's typed above)
ui.sign_in_with_a_user_account: Sign in with a user account
ui.for_a_mysttiq_with_authentication_on_: For a MystTiq with authentication on (remote access). The Owner creates accounts on the Security page. What you can do follows your account's role.
ui.ends_this_session_on_the_server_and_f: Ends this session on the server and forgets the saved token for this profile.
ui.editable_on_the_workspace_page_which_: Editable on the Workspace page, which is the one authoritative place for these paths.
ui.configuration_is_validated_before_wri: Configuration is validated before writing and a rollback .bak is created. Changes apply after the MystTiq system service is restarted. Authentication/TLS security settings are displayed but are not weakened by this editor.
ui.https_uses_normal_os_certificate_vali: HTTPS uses normal OS certificate validation unless an explicit SHA-256 certificate pin is configured.
ui.closes_this_tab_disabled_if_it_s_the_: Closes this tab. Disabled if it's the only open tab.
ui.how_should_this_new_server_s_world_st: How should this new server's world start out?
ui.installs_the_palworld_dedicated_serve: Installs the Palworld dedicated server fresh and creates a brand-new default world.
ui.installs_fresh_then_brings_in_a_world: Installs fresh, then brings in a world archive from a backup or another server.
ui.copies_an_already_configured_server_s: Copies an already-configured server's binaries, world, and settings into this new one, with ports offset automatically.
ui.step_3_of_8_clone_an_existing_server: Step 3 of 8 — Clone an Existing Server
ui.pick_a_server_you_ve_already_set_up_t: Pick a server you've already set up to copy from. It must be stopped first -- files can't be safely copied while PalServer has them open.
ui.these_values_are_applied_automaticall: These values are applied automatically right after Install (step 6) creates PalWorldSettings.ini -- nothing here is saved yet. This is the Palworld dedicated server's own name/settings -- separate from the Profile Name above, which only labels this MystTiq connection.
ui.optional_sent_only_to_the_authenticat: Optional; sent only to the authenticated headless service
ui.only_change_game_port_if_you_re_runni: Only change Game Port if you're running multiple Palworld servers on this same machine at the same time -- each needs its own port. Otherwise the default is fine.
ui.apply_a_starter_preset_automatically_: Apply a starter preset automatically after install, or customize your own once the server's real settings file exists.
ui.pick_a_preset_vanilla_quality_of_life: Pick a preset (Vanilla, Quality of Life, etc.) below -- applied automatically right after install.
ui.finish_setup_with_defaults_then_fine_: Finish setup with defaults, then fine-tune every World Setting on the Configuration page.
ui.continuing_registers_this_as_a_new_se: Continuing registers this as a new server profile and restarts the local MystTiq service automatically to bring it online, then reconnects this wizard to it. Only available for local, non-Windows-Service MystTiq installs.
ui.step_6_of_8_install_palworld_dedicate: Step 6 of 8 — Install Palworld Dedicated Server
ui.downloads_and_installs_the_palworld_d: Downloads and installs the Palworld dedicated server via SteamCMD (also installs SteamCMD itself if it's missing). Safe to run again later -- it validates rather than reinstalling if the files already exist.
ui.i_reviewed_this_plan_and_confirm_the_: I reviewed this plan and confirm the server is stopped.
ui.installs_the_server_then_automaticall: Installs the server, then automatically installs the newest stable UE4SS release. Palworld Save Tools and PIM/Oodle Decoder have no install capability anywhere in the app yet.
ui.installing_is_optional_here_if_the_fi: Installing is optional here if the files already exist at this location. Applies Identity & Ports and any chosen preset automatically.
ui.optional_scans_locally_installed_stea: Optional. Scans locally installed Steam Workshop content for Palworld and imports any you pick before finishing setup. You can always add more later from MOD Library.
ui.once_connected_create_palworldsetting: Once connected, create PalWorldSettings.ini from the server's official default file. Existing active settings are never overwritten. This is the Palworld dedicated server's own name/settings -- separate from the Profile Name above, which only labels this MystTiq connection.
ui.i_confirm_creation_of_a_new_settings_: I confirm creation of a new settings file
ui.starter_preset_optional_applied_after: Starter Preset (optional, applied after Create Default Settings above)
ui.requires_confirmation_the_headless_se: Requires confirmation. The headless service validates the values and refuses to overwrite an existing PalWorldSettings.ini. Connect first -- this writes to the server you just connected to.
ui.creating_default_settings_here_is_opt: Creating default settings here is optional -- skip ahead if this server already has its own PalWorldSettings.ini.
ui.save_this_profile_to_add_it_to_your_s: Save this profile to add it to your server list. You can always come back and finish the in-game defaults later from Settings.
ui.server_identity_description_and_ports: Server identity, description, and ports were applied automatically after install.
ui.your_chosen_starter_preset_was_applie: Your chosen starter preset was applied automatically.
ui.customize_world_settings_any_time_fro: Customize World Settings any time from Server → Configuration on this server.
ui.save_this_profile_to_add_it_to_your_s: Save this profile to add it to your server list.
ui.elapsed_time_since_this_operation_sta: Elapsed time since this operation started.
ui.a_fresh_safety_backup_is_taken_automa: A fresh safety backup is taken automatically before this change.
ui.this_permanently_deletes_the_player_s: This permanently deletes the player's save file. A fresh safety backup is taken automatically first, and this cannot be undone except by restoring it.
ui.terminate_the_server_immediately_and_: Terminate the server immediately and exit -- skips the graceful shutdown.
ui.stop_the_server_gracefully_then_exit: Stop the server gracefully, then exit.
ui.a_fresh_safety_backup_is_taken_automa: A fresh safety backup is taken automatically before this change. Requires PalServer stopped.
ui.safe_exit_stop_server_and_management_: Safe Exit — stop server and management backend
ui.force_exit_terminate_server_and_manag: Force Exit — terminate server and management backend
ui.exit_gui_only_keep_services_running: Exit GUI Only — keep services running
